title: No blood test record yet
body: This page has no data source. Health Connect stores a blood glucose or blood pressure reading a device measured, not a laboratory panel, so there is nothing to read here and deliberately no example result: a lab value the app invented would be indistinguishable from a real one.

title: What would fill it
body: A lab result is a document the owner receives, so it needs somewhere to be filed. The candidates the constellation already runs are a folder of JSON records under data/files/ browsed the way Buro > Wallet browses the wallet, or Buro > Docs. Whichever lands, this page becomes a `cards` stack over it and stops being a note.
